courses.title: SAT Math
courses.desc: Algebra, Advanced Math, ma'lumotlar tahlili va geometriya — noldan boshlab qisqa darslar.

topics.title: Chiziqli tenglamalar
lesson: Chiziqli tenglama — o'zgaruvchi faqat birinchi darajada qatnashgan tenglama, masalan 3x + 5 = 20.
Maqsad: x ni yolg'iz qoldirish. Ikkala tomonga bir xil amalni bajaramiz: qo'shish/ayirish, keyin ko'paytirish/bo'lish.
Qavs bo'lsa, avval qavsni oching; kasr bo'lsa, ikkala tomonni maxrajlarning umumiy karralisiga ko'paytiring.
keys: ax + b = c  ⇒  x = (c − b) / a
Cheksiz ko'p yechim: ikkala tomon bir xil bo'lib qoladi (masalan 2x + 4 = 2(x + 2))
Yechim yo'q: x lar qisqarib, noto'g'ri tenglik qoladi (masalan 3 = 5)

example.q: Agar 4(x − 3) + 2 = 2x + 6 bo'lsa, x ning qiymati nechaga teng?

practice.q: 5x − 7 = 18 bo'lsa, x = ?
practice.expl: 5x = 25, demak x = 5.

practice.q: (x + 4)/3 = 6 bo'lsa, x ning qiymati qancha?
practice.expl: Ikkala tomonni 3 ga ko'paytiramiz: x + 4 = 18, x = 14.

practice.q: 3(2x + 1) = 6x + k tenglama cheksiz ko'p yechimga ega. k = ?
practice.expl: Chap tomon 6x + 3. Ikkala tomon bir xil bo'lishi uchun k = 3.

topics.title: Chiziqli funksiyalar va og'ma (slope)
lesson: Chiziqli funksiya y = mx + b ko'rinishida yoziladi. m — og'ma (slope), b — y o'qini kesish nuqtasi (y-intercept).
Og'ma — x 1 ga oshganda y qanchaga o'zgarishi. Ikki nuqta orqali: m = (y₂ − y₁)/(x₂ − x₁).
Masalalarda b ko'pincha boshlang'ich qiymat (masalan, boshlang'ich to'lov), m esa har birlik uchun o'zgarish (masalan, har soat uchun narx).

example.q: Chiziq (2, 5) va (6, 17) nuqtalardan o'tadi. Uning tenglamasini toping.
steps: y = 3x + b ga (2, 5) ni qo'yamiz: 5 = 6 + b

practice.q: (1, 2) va (4, 11) nuqtalardan o'tuvchi chiziqning og'masi qancha?
Taksi narxi C = 2.5m + 4 formula bilan hisoblanadi (m — mil). 4 soni nimani bildiradi?
practice.expl: m = 0 bo'lganda ham C = 4 — bu boshlang'ich (qat'iy) to'lov.

practice.q: y = −2x + 7 ga perpendikulyar chiziqning og'masi qancha?
practice.expl: Perpendikulyar og'ma: −1/(−2) = 1/2.

topics.title: Tenglamalar sistemasi
lesson: Ikki noma'lumli ikki tenglama — sistema. Yechim — ikkala tenglamani bir vaqtda qanoatlantiruvchi (x, y) juftlik.
O'rniga qo'yish usuli: bitta tenglamadan x yoki y ni ifodalab, ikkinchisiga qo'yamiz.
Qo'shish (eliminatsiya) usuli: tenglamalarni biror songa ko'paytirib, qo'shganda bitta o'zgaruvchi yo'qoladigan qilamiz. Desmos'da ikkala chiziqning kesishgan nuqtasini ham ko'rish mumkin.
keys: Yechim yo'q: og'malar teng, b lar har xil (parallel)
Cheksiz yechim: ikkala tenglama bir xil chiziq

example.q: x + y = 10 va 2x − y = 5 bo'lsa, x va y ni toping.

practice.q: y = 2x va x + y = 12 bo'lsa, y = ?
3x + 2y = 16 va x − 2y = 0 bo'lsa, x = ?
practice.expl: Qo'shamiz: 4x = 16, x = 4.

practice.q: 2x + 3y = 6 va 4x + ky = 5 sistemaning yechimi yo'q. k = ?
practice.expl: Parallel bo'lishi uchun ikkinchi tenglamaning x, y koeffitsientlari birinchisinikidan 2 barobar bo'lishi kerak: k = 6 (o'ng tomon 12 emas, 5 — shuning uchun yechim yo'q).

topics.title: Chiziqli tengsizliklar
lesson: Tengsizlik tenglama kabi yechiladi, faqat bitta muhim qoida bor: manfiy songa ko'paytirsangiz yoki bo'lsangiz, belgi teskari tomonga o'giriladi.
SAT'da ko'pincha matnli masalalar: "kamida" — ≥, "ko'pi bilan" / "oshmasligi kerak" — ≤.
Ikki o'zgaruvchili tengsizliklarda nuqta yechim ekanini tekshirish uchun uni tengsizlikka qo'yib ko'ring.

example.q: Ali har soatiga 12 dollar ishlaydi. U kamida 300 dollar yig'ishi kerak. Kamida necha soat ishlashi kerak?

practice.q: −3x + 4 ≤ 19 tengsizlikning yechimi qaysi?
practice.expl: −3x ≤ 15; −3 ga bo'lganda belgi o'giriladi: x ≥ −5.

practice.q: Lift ko'pi bilan 1000 kg ko'taradi. Operator 80 kg, har bir quti 30 kg. Qaysi tengsizlik mos keladi (b — qutilar soni)?
practice.expl: Umumiy og'irlik 80 + 30b, u 1000 dan oshmasligi kerak: ≤.

practice.q: Qaysi nuqta y > 2x + 1 tengsizlikni qanoatlantiradi?
practice.expl: (0, 2): 2 > 1 — to'g'ri. Qolganlarida chap tomon katta emas.

topics.title: Kvadrat tenglamalar
lesson: Kvadrat tenglama: ax² + bx + c = 0. Uni ko'paytuvchilarga ajratish, diskriminant formulasi yoki Desmos yordamida yechish mumkin.
Diskriminant D = b² − 4ac: D > 0 — ikki yechim, D = 0 — bitta yechim, D < 0 — haqiqiy yechim yo'q.
Viet teoremasi: ildizlar yig'indisi = −b/a, ko'paytmasi = c/a. SAT'da ko'p vaqt tejaydi.

example.q: x² − 5x + 6 = 0 tenglamaning ildizlarini toping.

practice.q: x² − 9 = 0 tenglamaning musbat ildizi qancha?
practice.expl: x² = 9 ⇒ x = ±3, musbati 3.

practice.q: 2x² − 8x + 3 = 0 ildizlarining yig'indisi qancha?
practice.expl: Yig'indi = −b/a = 8/2 = 4.

practice.q: x² + 6x + k = 0 tenglama aynan bitta yechimga ega. k = ?

topics.title: Darajalar va ildizlar
lesson: Daraja qoidalari: bir xil asosli darajalarni ko'paytirganda ko'rsatkichlar qo'shiladi, bo'lganda ayiriladi, darajani darajaga oshirganda ko'paytiriladi.
Manfiy daraja — teskari son: a^(−n) = 1/a^n. Nolinchi daraja: a^0 = 1.
Kasr daraja — ildiz: a^(1/n) = ⁿ√a, a^(m/n) = (ⁿ√a)^m.

example.q: (x^3 · x^5) / x^2 ni soddalashtiring.

practice.expl: Asoslar bir xil, ko'rsatkichlar qo'shiladi: 2^7.

practice.q: 16^(3/4) ning qiymati qancha?
x > 0 bo'lsa, √(x^6) qaysiga teng?

topics.title: Eksponensial o'sish va kamayish
lesson: Eksponensial funksiya: y = a · b^x. a — boshlang'ich qiymat, b — har davrdagi ko'paytuvchi.
b > 1 bo'lsa — o'sish (masalan, har yili 5% o'sish: b = 1.05). 0 < b < 1 bo'lsa — kamayish (har yili 20% kamayish: b = 0.80).
Chiziqli va eksponensialni farqlang: chiziqli — har safar bir xil SON qo'shiladi; eksponensial — har safar bir xil FOIZga o'zgaradi.
keys: Har 2 yilda ikki barobar: y = a · 2^(t/2)

example.q: Shahar aholisi 50 000 va har yili 4% ga oshadi. 3 yildan keyingi aholini ifodalovchi formula qaysi?

practice.q: V = 800(0.9)^t formulada mashina narxi har yili necha foizga kamayadi?
practice.expl: b = 0.9 = 1 − 0.10, demak har yili 10% kamayadi.

practice.q: Bakteriyalar soni har soatda 3 barobar oshadi. Boshida 200 ta. 2 soatdan keyin nechta?
Qaysi jadval eksponensial funksiyani ifodalaydi (x = 0, 1, 2, 3)?
practice.expl: Har qadamda 2 ga ko'payadi — bir xil ko'paytuvchi, demak eksponensial.

topics.title: Funksiyalar: f(x) va grafiklar
lesson: f(x) — x ga bog'liq qiymat. f(3) ni topish uchun formuladagi har bir x o'rniga 3 ni qo'yamiz.
Grafikdan o'qish: f(a) — x = a bo'lgandagi y qiymati; f(x) = 0 bo'lgan nuqtalar — x o'qini kesish nuqtalari (nollar).
Siljishlar: f(x) + k — k birlik yuqoriga, f(x − h) — h birlik o'ngga, −f(x) — x o'qiga nisbatan akslantirish.
keys: f(x − h) + k: o'ngga h, yuqoriga k
Murakkab funksiya: f(g(x)) — avval g, keyin f

example.q: f(x) = 2x² − 3x + 1 bo'lsa, f(−2) ni toping.

practice.q: f(x) = 5x − 3 bo'lsa, f(4) = ?
g(x) = x² bo'lsa, y = g(x − 3) + 2 grafigining uchi qayerda?
practice.expl: 3 birlik o'ngga, 2 birlik yuqoriga: (3, 2).

practice.q: f(x) = x + 1 va g(x) = 2x bo'lsa, f(g(3)) = ?

topics.title: Nisbat, proporsiya va foizlar
lesson: Nisbat a : b — ikki miqdorni solishtirish. Proporsiya — ikki nisbatning tengligi: a/b = c/d ⇒ ad = bc.
Foiz — yuzdan bir qism. x ning p% i = x · p/100. Foizli o'zgarish = (yangi − eski)/eski · 100%.
Birliklarni almashtirish: kerakmas birlik qisqaradigan kasrlarga ko'paytiring (masalan, 1 soat/60 daqiqa).

example.q: Kurtka narxi 80 dollardan 20% chegirma bilan sotilyapti. Yangi narx qancha?

practice.q: Sinfda o'g'il va qizlar nisbati 3 : 5. Jami 32 o'quvchi. Qizlar nechta?
practice.expl: 32 ni 8 qismga bo'lamiz: har qism 4. Qizlar 5·4 = 20.

practice.q: Narx 50 dan 65 ga oshdi. Necha foiz oshgan?
Mashina 3 soatda 180 km yuradi. Shu tezlikda 5 soatda qancha yuradi?
practice.expl: Tezlik 60 km/soat, 60·5 = 300 km.

topics.title: Statistika: o'rtacha, mediana, tarqoqlik
lesson: O'rtacha (mean) — barcha qiymatlar yig'indisi / soni. Mediana — tartiblangan ro'yxatning o'rtasidagi qiymat. Moda — eng ko'p takrorlangan.
Juda katta yoki kichik qiymat (outlier) o'rtachaga kuchli ta'sir qiladi, medianaga esa kam ta'sir qiladi.
Standart og'ish va diapazon (range = max − min) — ma'lumotlar qanchalik tarqoqligini ko'rsatadi.
keys: Juft sonli ro'yxatda mediana — o'rtadagi ikkitasining o'rtachasi
Outlier olib tashlansa, o'rtacha ko'proq o'zgaradi

example.q: 5 ta testning o'rtacha bali 82. Oltinchi testdan keyin o'rtacha 84 bo'lishi uchun 6-testdan necha ball olish kerak?

practice.q: 3, 7, 8, 10, 12 sonlarining medianasi qancha?
practice.expl: Tartiblangan, o'rtadagi (3-chi) son — 8.

practice.q: 4, 6, 9, 13 sonlarining medianasi qancha?
practice.expl: O'rtadagi ikkitasi 6 va 9: (6 + 9)/2 = 7.5.

practice.q: Ro'yxatga juda katta son qo'shildi. Qaysi biri ko'proq o'zgaradi?
practice.expl: Outlier o'rtachani kuchli siljitadi, mediana deyarli o'zgarmaydi.

topics.title: Ehtimollik va ikki tomonlama jadvallar
lesson: Ehtimollik = qulay natijalar soni / barcha natijalar soni. U 0 dan 1 gacha bo'ladi.
Ikki tomonlama jadvalda savolning "...lar orasidan" qismiga diqqat qiling — aynan o'sha guruh maxrajga yoziladi.
"Tasodifan tanlangan o'quvchi qiz bo'lsa" — shartli ehtimollik: maxraj faqat qizlar soni.

example.q: Jadval: Qizlar — sport bilan shug'ullanadi 18, shug'ullanmaydi 12. O'g'illar — 20 va 10. Tanlangan o'quvchi qiz bo'lsa, uning sport bilan shug'ullanish ehtimoli?

practice.q: Qopda 4 ta qizil, 6 ta ko'k shar bor. Tasodifan olingan shar qizil bo'lish ehtimoli?
Yuqoridagi misol jadvalida (qizlar 18/12, o'g'illar 20/10) tasodifiy o'quvchining sport bilan shug'ullanish ehtimoli?
practice.expl: Jami 60 o'quvchi, sport bilan 18 + 20 = 38: 38/60.

practice.q: Yomg'ir yog'ish ehtimoli 0.35. Yog'maslik ehtimoli?

topics.title: Burchaklar va uchburchaklar
lesson: Uchburchak ichki burchaklari yig'indisi 180°. To'g'ri chiziqdagi qo'shni burchaklar yig'indisi ham 180°.
Pifagor teoremasi (to'g'ri burchakli uchburchak): a² + b² = c², c — gipotenuza. Tez-tez uchraydigan uchliklar: 3-4-5, 5-12-13, 8-15-17.
Maxsus uchburchaklar: 45-45-90 da tomonlar x, x, x√2; 30-60-90 da x, x√3, 2x. O'xshash uchburchaklarda mos tomonlar nisbati teng.

example.q: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakning katetlari 6 va 8. Gipotenuzani toping.

practice.q: Uchburchakning ikki burchagi 50° va 75°. Uchinchi burchak?
Gipotenuza 13, bir katet 5. Ikkinchi katet?
30-60-90 uchburchakda eng qisqa tomon 4. Gipotenuza?
practice.expl: Gipotenuza eng qisqa tomondan 2 barobar: 8.

topics.title: Aylana
lesson: Aylana uzunligi C = 2πr, doira yuzi A = πr². Diametr d = 2r.
Aylana tenglamasi: (x − h)² + (y − k)² = r², bu yerda (h, k) — markaz, r — radius.
Yoy va sektor: markaziy burchak 360° ning qanday qismi bo'lsa, yoy uzunligi ham aylana uzunligining shuncha qismi bo'ladi.

example.q: (x − 2)² + (y + 5)² = 49 aylananing markazi va radiusini toping.

practice.q: Radiusi 5 bo'lgan doiraning yuzi?
practice.expl: πr² = 25π.

practice.q: x² + (y − 3)² = 16 aylananing radiusi?
Radiusi 6 bo'lgan aylanada 60° li markaziy burchakka mos yoy uzunligi?

topics.title: Yuza va hajm
lesson: Asosiy yuzalar: to'rtburchak a·b, uchburchak (1/2)·asos·balandlik, trapetsiya (a + b)/2 · h.
Hajmlar: to'g'ri burchakli parallelepiped l·w·h, silindr πr²h. Konus, piramida va shar formulalari SAT'da formula sahifasida beriladi.
Masshtab: uzunliklar k marta oshsa, yuza k² marta, hajm k³ marta oshadi.
keys: Masshtab k: yuza × k², hajm × k³

example.q: Silindrning radiusi 3, balandligi 10. Hajmini toping.

practice.q: Asosi 10, balandligi 6 bo'lgan uchburchak yuzi?
Kubning qirrasi 2 barobar oshirildi. Hajmi necha marta oshadi?
practice.expl: Hajm k³ marta: 2³ = 8.

practice.q: O'lchamlari 4, 5 va 3 bo'lgan quti hajmi?

topics.title: Trigonometriya asoslari
lesson: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda: sin = qarama-qarshi katet / gipotenuza, cos = yopishgan katet / gipotenuza, tan = qarama-qarshi / yopishgan. Eslab qolish: SOH-CAH-TOA.
Muhim xossa: sin x = cos(90° − x). SAT bu xossani ko'p so'raydi.
Radian: 180° = π radian. Gradusni radianga o'tkazish uchun π/180 ga ko'paytiring.
keys: sin = qar./gip., cos = yop./gip., tan = qar./yop.

example.q: Uchburchak tomonlari 3, 4, 5. 3 ga qarama-qarshi burchak A bo'lsa, sin A va cos A ni toping.
steps: Gipotenuza 5, A ga qarama-qarshi katet 3, yopishgan katet 4

practice.q: Tomonlari 5, 12, 13 bo'lgan uchburchakda 5 ga qarama-qarshi burchakning tangensi?
practice.expl: tan = qarama-qarshi/yopishgan = 5/12.

practice.q: 90° necha radian?

courses.title: SAT English
courses.desc: Reading & Writing: so'z ma'nosi, matn tahlili, grammatika va tinish belgilari.

topics.title: Words in Context (so'z ma'nosi)
lesson: Bu savollarda matndagi bo'sh joyga eng mantiqiy va aniq so'zni tanlaysiz yoki so'zning shu matndagi ma'nosini topasiz.
Usul: variantlarga qaramasdan avval bo'sh joyga o'zingizning oddiy so'zingizni qo'ying (masalan, "yaxshi", "kamaydi"). Keyin shu ma'noga eng yaqin variantni tanlang.
Kontekstdagi kalit so'zlarga e'tibor bering: "however", "although" — qarama-qarshilik; "because", "thus" — sabab-natija.
keys: Avval o'z so'zingizni toping, keyin variantga qarang

example.q:
Although the scientist's early results were promising, she remained ______, insisting that more trials were needed before drawing conclusions.
A) cautious
B) careless
C) triumphant
D) indifferent
steps: "Although" — natijalar yaxshi, LEKIN u ehtiyotkor edi
"insisting that more trials were needed" — yana sinovlar kerak, demak ehtiyotkor

practice.q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word?
practice.expl: Qurg'oqchilik davrida suv "kam" bo'ladi — scarce.
practice.passage: During the long drought, water became so ______ that villagers had to walk several miles each day to fill a single bucket.

practice.q: As used in the text, what does the word "sharp" most nearly mean?
practice.expl: Sotuvlar bir oyda keskin kamaydi — "sudden" (to'satdan, keskin).
practice.passage: After the new policy was announced, the company saw a sharp decline in sales, dropping by nearly half in a single month.

practice.q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word?
practice.expl: Yangi dalillar eski nazariyaga qarshi chiqdi — challenged (shubha ostiga qo'ydi).
practice.passage: For decades, historians believed the city was abandoned because of war. However, new evidence of severe flooding has ______ that long-held view.

topics.title: Text Structure and Purpose
lesson: Bu savollar matn NIMA uchun yozilgani yoki matndagi bir gap qanday VAZIFA bajarishini so'raydi.
Har bir gapning rolini qisqa belgilab chiqing: "fon ma'lumot", "da'vo", "misol", "qarshi fikr", "xulosa".
To'g'ri javob matnning HAMMASIni qamraydi, lekin undan tashqariga chiqmaydi. Juda kuchli fe'llar ("proves", "refutes") ko'pincha tuzoq.

example.q:
Matn: Bees are often praised for making honey. Yet their most important contribution is pollination: about one-third of the food we eat depends on it.
Savol: Matnning asosiy maqsadi nima?
steps: 2-gap: "Yet" — muhimroq narsa: changlatish va raqamli dalil
Maqsad: asalarilarning eng muhim roli boshqa narsa ekanini ko'rsatish
Javob: to emphasize a less-recognized but more important role of bees

practice.q: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence (the second sentence) in the text as a whole?
choices: It offers a solution to a problem.
It introduces a claim that the rest of the text disputes.
It provides an example that supports the claim in the first sentence.
practice.expl: 1-gap: shaharlar qizib ketadi. 2-gap: Feniks misoli — da'voni qo'llab-quvvatlovchi misol.
practice.passage: Cities are often several degrees warmer than surrounding rural areas. In Phoenix, for example, nighttime temperatures can be up to 6°C higher than in nearby desert. Researchers call this the urban heat island effect.

practice.q: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
choices: To criticize the writer's use of multiple narrators
To explain why a writer chose an unusual structure for her novel
To argue that all novels should be shorter
practice.expl: Matn yozuvchining nega romanni teskari tartibda yozganini tushuntiradi.
practice.passage: Novelist Mira Hol tells her latest story in reverse, beginning with the final scene. Hol has said she wanted readers to focus not on what happens but on why it happens.

practice.q: Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
choices: It describes a process step by step.
It presents a common belief and then offers evidence against it.
practice.expl: Avval keng tarqalgan fikr (oltin baliq xotirasi 3 soniya), keyin unga qarshi dalil.
practice.passage: Many people believe goldfish have a memory span of only three seconds. However, studies show that goldfish can be trained to respond to sounds and can remember them for months.

topics.title: Cross-Text Connections
lesson: Ikki qisqa matn beriladi va savol: "Text 2 muallifi Text 1 dagi fikrga qanday munosabatda bo'ladi?"
Har bir matnning asosiy da'vosini bitta gap bilan yozib oling. Keyin ular: rozi, qarshi, qisman rozi yoki qo'shimcha qiladimi — aniqlang.
To'g'ri javob ikkala matndagi aniq so'zlarga tayanadi. Faqat bitta matnga tegishli variantlar — tuzoq.

example.q:
Text 1: Homework improves student achievement at all ages.
Text 2: Research shows homework helps high school students, but has little effect in elementary school.
Text 2 muallifi Text 1 ga qanday javob beradi?
steps: Text 2 qisman rozi, lekin da'voni cheklaydi
Javob: It would argue that the claim is true only for some students.

practice.q: Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the claim in Text 1?
choices: By claiming that offices should be closed
By arguing that the benefit depends on the type of task
By stating that productivity cannot be measured
By agreeing that remote work always increases productivity
practice.expl: Text 2: ijodiy hamkorlikda pasayadi, individual ishda oshadi — foyda vazifa turiga bog'liq.
practice.passage:
Text 1: A study of 500 employees found that working from home increased productivity by 13%.
Text 2: Remote work helps with focused individual tasks, but teams working on creative projects together often perform worse when they are apart.

practice.q: Which choice best describes the relationship between the two texts?
choices: Text 2 provides evidence that supports Text 1.
Text 2 rejects the method used in Text 1.
Text 2 repeats Text 1 without adding information.
practice.expl: Text 2 yangi tadqiqot bilan Text 1 dagi fikrni tasdiqlaydi.
practice.passage:
Text 1: Some ecologists suggest that wolves reintroduced to Yellowstone helped rivers recover by reducing overgrazing by elk.
Text 2: A 2020 survey found that willow trees along Yellowstone's rivers grew significantly taller in areas where wolves were most active.

practice.q: How would the author of Text 2 most likely view the approach in Text 1?
practice.expl: Text 2 "foydali, lekin yetarli emas" deydi — useful but incomplete.
practice.passage:
Text 1: Satellite images allow scientists to track deforestation across huge areas quickly.
Text 2: Satellite data is valuable, but without ground visits researchers cannot tell whether a forest is being cut or is simply losing leaves in a dry season.

topics.title: Central Ideas and Details
lesson: Asosiy g'oya — matn umuman nima haqida ekanini bildiruvchi fikr. Detal savollari esa matnda aniq aytilgan ma'lumotni so'raydi.
Matnni o'qib bo'lgach, "Muallif menga nima demoqchi?" savoliga 10 so'zdan kam javob yozing.
Detal savollarida javob MATNDA bo'lishi shart. O'z bilimingiz yoki taxminingizga tayanmang.
keys: Juda tor yoki juda keng javoblardan saqlaning

example.q:
Matn: The octopus has three hearts and blue blood. Two hearts pump blood to the gills, while the third pumps it to the rest of the body. Its blue blood contains copper, which carries oxygen efficiently in cold water.
Savol: Asosiy g'oya nima?
steps: Matn sakkizoyoqning qon aylanish tizimini tasvirlaydi
Javob: The octopus has an unusual circulatory system suited to its environment.

practice.q: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
choices: Digital books are cheaper than printed books.
Modern libraries have expanded their role beyond lending books.
Most people prefer reading at home.
practice.expl: Matn kutubxonalar endi kurslar, internet va yig'inlar joyi ekanini aytadi — rol kengaygan.
practice.passage: Public libraries today do far more than lend books. Many offer free internet access, job-training workshops, language classes, and meeting spaces for community groups.

practice.q: According to the text, why did the farmers switch crops?
choices: Because rice was difficult to harvest
Because the new crop needed less water
practice.expl: Matnda aniq: tariq kamroq suv talab qiladi.
practice.passage: After three dry years, many farmers in the region replaced rice with millet, a grain that requires far less water to grow.

practice.q: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
choices: Sleep is only important for young children.
Sleep plays an active role in forming memories.
People need eight hours of sleep.
practice.expl: Matn: uyqu davomida miya kun davomida o'rganganlarini mustahkamlaydi.
practice.passage: Sleep was once seen as a time when the brain simply rests. Researchers now know that during sleep, the brain replays and strengthens the information learned during the day.

topics.title: Command of Evidence (Textual)
lesson: Savol: "Qaysi iqtibos/dalil muallifning da'vosini eng yaxshi qo'llab-quvvatlaydi?"
Avval da'voni aniq ajratib oling (masalan: "yozuvchi tabiatni do'st sifatida tasvirlaydi"). Keyin har bir variantni shu da'vo bilan solishtiring.
To'g'ri variant da'voning HAR IKKI qismini ham qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. Mavzuga oid, lekin da'voni isbotlamaydigan variantlar — tuzoq.
keys: Dalil da'voning barcha qismiga mos kelsin

example.q:
Da'vo: Poyafzal ishlab chiqaruvchi X kompaniyasi ekologik toza materiallardan foydalanadi.
Qaysi dalil eng yaxshi?
A) X kompaniyasining do'konlari ko'p.
B) X ning poyafzallari 90% qayta ishlangan plastikdan tayyorlanadi.
steps: B) qayta ishlangan material — aynan da'voni isbotlaydi

practice.q: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers' hypothesis?
choices: Plants exposed to music grew taller than plants kept in silence.
Plants in both groups grew to the same height.
Music was played for eight hours a day.
practice.expl: Gipoteza: musiqa o'sishni tezlashtiradi. Musiqa eshitgan o'simliklar balandroq — to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qo'llaydi.
practice.passage: Researchers hypothesized that exposure to classical music helps tomato plants grow faster. They placed one group of plants near speakers and kept another group in a silent room.

practice.q: Which quotation from a reader's review best supports the claim that the novel is difficult to put down?
choices: "It is the third book in a series."
"I stayed up until 3 a.m. because I had to know what happened next."
practice.expl: Kechasi soat 3 gacha o'qigan — kitobni qo'yib bo'lmaydi degan da'voni isbotlaydi.
practice.passage: Critics have praised the novel for its suspense, claiming that it is difficult to put down.

practice.q: Which finding would most weaken the claim that the new bike lanes reduced accidents?
choices: Accidents fell by the same amount in nearby cities without new bike lanes.
More people began cycling to work.
Accidents fell by 30% after the lanes were built.
practice.expl: Boshqa shaharlarda ham xuddi shunday kamaygan bo'lsa, sabab velo-yo'laklar emas bo'lishi mumkin — da'vo zaiflashadi.
practice.passage: City officials claim that new bike lanes built in 2022 caused the drop in traffic accidents that year.

topics.title: Command of Evidence (Quantitative)
lesson: Bu savollarda jadval yoki grafik bo'ladi va matndagi da'voni qo'llaydigan ma'lumotni tanlaysiz.
Avval matndagi da'voni o'qing, keyin grafikni. Grafikning sarlavhasi, o'qlari va birliklariga qarang.
Variant grafikdagi ma'lumotga to'g'ri bo'lishi YETARLI EMAS — u aynan da'voga tegishli bo'lishi kerak.

example.q:
Jadval: 2019 yilda A shahar aholisi 2 mln, B — 1.5 mln; 2023 yilda A — 2.1 mln, B — 1.9 mln.
Da'vo: B shahar A ga nisbatan tezroq o'smoqda. Qaysi ma'lumot qo'llaydi?
steps: Javob: B's population grew by 0.4 million, while A's grew by only 0.1 million.

practice.q: Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to support the student's claim?
choices: Cafe B's sales rose every day from Monday to Friday.
Cafe A's sales were highest on Wednesday.
Cafe A sold 120 coffees on Monday.
practice.expl: Da'vo — B savdosi hafta davomida muttasil oshgan. Faqat B varianti shuni ko'rsatadi.
practice.passage:
Table — Coffees sold. Cafe A: Mon 120, Tue 110, Wed 140, Thu 100, Fri 115. Cafe B: Mon 80, Tue 95, Wed 105, Thu 120, Fri 150.
A student claims that Cafe B's sales increased steadily over the week.

practice.q: Which choice best describes data from the graph that support the researcher's conclusion?
choices: Students who slept 8+ hours scored an average of 85, compared with 70 for those who slept under 6 hours.
practice.expl: Xulosa — ko'p uxlash yuqori ball bilan bog'liq. Faqat B variant ikki guruhni solishtiradi.
practice.passage:
Graph: average test score by nightly sleep. Under 6 hours: 70; 6–8 hours: 78; 8+ hours: 85.
The researcher concluded that more sleep was associated with higher test scores.

practice.q: Which choice uses data from the table to complete the statement accurately? "In 2020, the share of electricity from solar was ______."
choices: about four times what it was in 2015
practice.passage: Table — Share of electricity. 2015: coal 40%, wind 5%, solar 2%. 2020: coal 30%, wind 10%, solar 8%.

topics.title: Inferences (xulosa chiqarish)
lesson: Matnning oxirida bo'sh joy bo'ladi va siz uni eng mantiqiy xulosa bilan to'ldirasiz.
Xulosa matndagi faktlardan KELIB CHIQISHI shart. Qisqa "zanjir" tuzing: fakt 1 + fakt 2 ⇒ xulosa.
Juda uzoqqa ketuvchi, matnda asosi yo'q yoki juda umumlashtirilgan variantlardan saqlaning.

example.q: Matn: A species of lizard lives only on islands without snakes. On one island where snakes were recently introduced, the lizard population has dropped sharply. This suggests that ______.
steps: Fakt 1: kaltakesak faqat ilonsiz orollarda yashaydi
Javob: snakes are likely a threat to the lizard's survival.

practice.q: Which choice most logically completes the text?
choices: the painting is a copy made in 1700
the painter never used blue paint
practice.expl: Bo'yoq 1850 yildan keyin ixtiro qilingan, rasmda u bor ⇒ rasm 1850 dan keyin chizilgan.
practice.passage: A certain blue pigment was not invented until 1850. Scientists found this pigment throughout a painting long believed to date from 1790. This finding suggests that ______

practice.q: Which choice most logically completes the text?
choices: the trees grew faster during the drought
the trees are older than scientists thought
the drought affected the trees' growth
practice.expl: Qurg'oqchilik yillaridagi halqalar ingichka ⇒ qurg'oqchilik o'sishga ta'sir qilgan.
practice.passage: Trees add one growth ring each year, and wider rings indicate more growth. Rings from the years 2011–2014, when the region experienced severe drought, are unusually thin. This suggests that ______

practice.q: Which choice most logically completes the text?
choices: the tutoring program may have helped improve students' scores
practice.expl: Faqat qatnashganlarning bali oshgan ⇒ dastur yordam bergan bo'lishi mumkin (ehtiyotkor xulosa).
practice.passage: Students who attended an after-school math tutoring program raised their test scores by an average of 12 points, while students who did not attend showed almost no change. This suggests that ______

topics.title: Boundaries (tinish belgilari)
lesson: Bu savollar gaplar orasidagi chegarani to'g'ri belgilashni tekshiradi: nuqta, vergul, nuqtali vergul (;), ikki nuqta (:) va tire (—).
Ikkita mustaqil gap (independent clause) faqat vergul bilan ulanmaydi — bu xato (comma splice). To'g'ri: nuqta, nuqtali vergul yoki vergul + FANBOYS (for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so).
Ikki nuqta (:) dan oldin to'liq gap bo'lishi shart; undan keyin ro'yxat, tushuntirish yoki misol keladi.
keys: Ega va kesim orasiga vergul qo'yilmaydi

example.q:
The museum closed early ______ the staff needed to prepare for the new exhibit.
A) early, the
B) early; the
C) early the
D) early, and, the
steps: "the staff needed to prepare..." — ham to'liq gap
Faqat vergul — xato, hech narsasiz — xato

practice.q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
practice.expl: Ikki mustaqil gap: nuqtali vergul bilan ulanadi.
practice.passage: The game was delayed by heavy ______ players waited in the locker room for two hours.

practice.q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
practice.expl: To'liq gapdan keyin ro'yxat keladi — ikki nuqta.
practice.passage: The recipe requires only three ______ sugar, and butter.

practice.q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
practice.expl: Ega (the scientist George Washington Carver) va kesim (discovered) orasiga hech qanday belgi qo'yilmaydi.
practice.passage: The scientist George Washington ______ hundreds of uses for the peanut.

topics.title: Form, Structure, and Sense (grammatika)
lesson: Asosiy mavzular: ega va kesimning sonda moslashuvi (subject-verb agreement), olmoshlar (pronoun agreement), fe'l zamonlari va egalik shakllari (’s).
Ega-kesim: egani toping va orasidagi qo'shimcha so'zlarni ("of the students", "along with...") e'tiborsiz qoldiring. "The box of apples IS" — ega "box", birlik.
Olmosh o'zi almashtirayotgan otga mos bo'lishi kerak: ko'plik uchun they/their, birlik uchun it/its. its = uning, it's = it is.

example.q:
The collection of rare coins ______ displayed in the main hall.
A) are
B) is
C) were
D) have been

practice.q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
practice.expl: Ega "list" — birlik, shuning uchun "is".
practice.passage: The list of books recommended by the teachers ______ posted on the library door.

practice.q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
practice.expl: Kompaniya — birlik, egalik: its.
practice.passage: The company announced that ______ new headquarters will open in March.

practice.q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
practice.expl: "Each of the players" — ega "each", birlik: has.
practice.passage: Each of the players ______ a different role on the team.

topics.title: Transitions (bog'lovchi so'zlar)
lesson: Bo'sh joydan oldingi va keyingi gaplar orasidagi mantiqiy munosabatni aniqlang, keyin mos bog'lovchini tanlang.

Asosiy guruhlar: Qarama-qarshilik — however, nevertheless, in contrast. Qo'shimcha — moreover, furthermore, additionally. Natija — therefore, thus, as a result. Misol — for example, for instance. Ketma-ketlik — then, finally.
Maslahat: bo'sh joyni o'qimasdan avval ikki gap munosabatini o'zbekcha ayting: "lekin", "shuning uchun", "masalan"...

example.q:
Electric cars produce no exhaust. ______, they are much quieter than gasoline cars.
A) However
B) Moreover
C) Therefore
D) For example

practice.q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
practice.expl: Kutish — oson, natija — qiyin: qarama-qarshilik.
practice.passage: Many expected the new bridge to be finished within a year. ______, construction problems delayed it for nearly three years.

practice.q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
practice.expl: Ko'p yomg'ir ⇒ yaxshi hosil: natija.
practice.passage: The spring was unusually rainy. ______, farmers in the valley harvested a record crop of wheat.

practice.q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
practice.expl: Birinchi gap umumiy fikr, ikkinchisi aniq misol.
practice.passage: Some animals use tools to find food. ______, sea otters use rocks to crack open shellfish.

topics.title: Rhetorical Synthesis
lesson: Sizga talabaning qisqa qaydlari (bullet notes) va maqsad beriladi: "The student wants to emphasize..." yoki "...compare two...".
Qaydlarni to'liq o'qish shart emas! Avval savoldagi MAQSADni o'qing va unga aniq mos keladigan variantni tanlang.
Maqsad "farqni ko'rsatish" bo'lsa — ikki narsani solishtiruvchi gap; "auditoriyaga tanishtirish" bo'lsa — kim/nima ekanini tushuntiruvchi gap kerak.
keys: Faktlar to'g'ri, lekin maqsadga mos emas — tuzoq

example.q:
Qaydlar: • Amazon daryosi — 6400 km. • Nil daryosi — 6650 km.
Maqsad: ikkala daryo uzunligidagi farqni ta'kidlash.
steps: Variant ikkala daryo va farqni ko'rsatishi kerak
Javob: The Nile, at 6,650 km, is about 250 km longer than the Amazon.

practice.q: The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two scientists. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes?
choices: Both Marie Curie and Dorothy Hodgkin won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
Marie Curie was born in Poland.
Dorothy Hodgkin studied the structure of insulin.
Curie won her prize in 1911, and Hodgkin won hers in 1964.
practice.expl: Maqsad — o'xshashlik. Faqat B ikkalasining umumiy jihatini aytadi.
practice.passage:
Notes:
• Marie Curie was born in Poland and won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1911.
• Dorothy Hodgkin was born in Egypt and won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1964.
• Hodgkin studied the structure of insulin.

practice.q: The student wants to introduce the Great Green Wall to an audience unfamiliar with it. Which choice most effectively accomplishes this goal?
choices: The Great Green Wall, an African project begun in 2007, aims to plant trees across the Sahel to stop the desert from spreading.
practice.expl: Tanishtirish uchun: nima ekanligi, qayerda va maqsadi — B barchasini beradi.
practice.passage:
Notes:
• The Great Green Wall is an African project started in 2007.
• It aims to plant trees across the Sahel region.
• Its goal is to stop the Sahara desert from spreading.

practice.q: The student wants to present the study's conclusion. Which choice most effectively accomplishes this goal?
choices: The study took place in Oslo.
The study concluded that walking 30 minutes a day improved participants' mood.
practice.expl: Maqsad — xulosa. Faqat C tadqiqot natijasini aytadi.
practice.passage:
Notes:
• Researchers in Oslo studied 200 adults.
• Participants walked 30 minutes a day for eight weeks.
• The study concluded that daily walking improved participants' mood.
